full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white studio portrait shows a shaggy puppet-like character holding a folded sheet of paper against a dark, softly graded background. The character fills most of the right and lower frame, with the upper left left open and shadowy. A large rounded nose projects from the center of the face, and two wide white eyes with small dark pupils look upward rather than at the page. Messy short fibers rise from the head, while longer strands form a thick moustache and beard around the mouth and chin. One rounded ear shows at the right edge of the head. The character wears a dark textured overcoat with a broad collar, its woven surface distinct from the softer fur. Large furry hands grasp the paper at the lower center and left; its creased surface angles up toward the left border. The paper has faint linear markings, but no words are legible. The mouth is a narrow dark line under the moustache, giving the upward gaze a curious, slightly surprised expression. Soft directional studio light from the upper left catches the forehead fibers, nose, hands, and paper fold, while the coat and lower background remain dense charcoal. Fine fibers are individually visible at the lit edges, though darker masses merge into broader shapes. The shallow backdrop carries a weak halo behind the head and no identifiable setting. The image feels materially tangible, with fuzzy pile, coarse fabric, and thin folded paper offering three different textures. The overall composition balances a bright face and angled paper against deep surrounding shade, making an intimate, humorous character study.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白影棚肖像呈现一只蓬松的布偶式角色，手拿一张折叠纸，站在深色、柔和渐变的背景前。角色占据画面右侧与下方大部，左上方则保持空旷暗淡。一个大圆鼻子从面部中央突出，两只宽大的白眼带小黑瞳，向上看而没有看纸。短而凌乱的纤维从头顶翘起，更长的毛形成厚胡须与下巴周围的胡子。头部右边缘露出一只圆耳朵。角色穿深色、有织物纹理的外套，领子宽大，粗织面与更柔软的毛发明显不同。宽大毛手在画面下方中央和左侧抓着纸；折痕明显的纸面向左边缘倾斜。纸上有淡淡线形痕迹，但没有可辨文字。嘴在胡须下只是一条窄暗线，向上的目光因而显得好奇、略微惊讶。来自左上方的柔和定向影棚光照亮额前绒毛、鼻子、手和纸折处，外套及下方背景仍是浓炭灰。受光边缘可见一根根细毛，较暗的部位则合成宽阔形体。浅空间背景在头后形成微弱光晕，没有可辨认的具体环境。画面有可触的材料感，蓬松绒面、粗织布料和轻薄折纸呈现三种不同质地。整体构图以明亮面部和斜纸片平衡周围深影，成为亲密而幽默的角色研究。
style_prompt_en: The image has a tactile studio-photographic finish, where soft pile, coarse weave, and thin creased surfaces remain visibly distinct. Dark charcoal occupies broad quiet areas, while small pale highlights define rounded volumes and individual fibers. Edges vary from crisp illuminated strands to merged shadow masses, giving the forms depth without a hard outline. A gently graded backdrop isolates the main silhouette and carries only a faint halo. Light arrives from one upper side, lifting projecting textures while the lower field stays dense. The composition combines a compact central mass with an angled light plane and ample dark negative space. The overall tone is intimate and playful, with material texture supplying the expressive detail.
style_prompt_zh: 画面具有可触的影棚摄影完成面，柔软绒毛、粗织纹与轻薄折面彼此清楚区分。深炭灰占据宽阔安静区域，少量浅色高光界定圆润体积与单根纤维。边缘从清晰的受光毛丝变化到融在一起的暗部色块，使形体无需硬轮廓也有纵深。柔和渐变背景隔离主要剪影，只留微弱光晕。光从一侧上方到来，抬亮突出的纹理，下方区域保持厚重。构图把紧凑的中央体块、斜向浅色平面和充足深色留白结合起来。整体气质亲密而俏皮，材料肌理提供主要表情细节。
theme_en: A shaggy puppet in a dark coat holding a folded paper in a monochrome studio portrait
theme_zh: 一只穿深外套、手持折纸的毛绒布偶黑白影棚肖像
name: Jim Henson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
